subject: bench: context injector — sliding window fetcher
description:
Implement a sliding window context fetcher for the context-injection bench.

Goal: return the last K complete_task summaries from the orchestrator regardless of cosine similarity — recency, not relevance.

Implement as /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/scripts/context-inject-sliding-window.js:
- GET http://localhost:8787/api/graph?scope=frontier&compact=true
- Filter nodes with status=done, sort by completedAt desc, take first K (default 5)
- Return array of { task_key, title, summary }
- Export: async function getWindowContext(k = 5) → array

No LLM call — pure REST.
Self-test: node scripts/context-inject-sliding-window.js --test prints last 5 summaries.
